summary: The Project Settings project tree now loads from a single project-registry read instead of opening every project's field-mapping file, so it opens quickly on client PCs over the network drive.
details: Removed the legacy spreadsheet-shaped project map payload and the dead /project_book compatibility endpoints; the registry API now serves folders plus project paths directly from projects/index.json.
The CSV import path is committed through the import-profile save and read per selected project, and field-mapping saves preserve the stored path.
Project duplication recovery records no longer carry a project-row fingerprint; finalization idempotently ensures the duplicated project's registry path.
